turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I've got twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't anyone call me first?
You haven't answered my question. Who decided, and why didn't anyone call me?
We're not finished, Hale. Sit down and tell me who entered that zero before anyone picked up a phone.
No, it doesn't. You asked for this meeting, so start explaining that zero.
